messages:
zoe-partnerops: Partner 'NimbusGrid' reported billing noise after switching to the new marketplace SDK. they see duplicated usage rows with same event_ts but different sku casing.
kevin-revops: can you paste a sanitized example?
zoe-partnerops: snippet:
```
{customer: 'nimbus-11', event_ts: '2026-03-22T20:12:00Z', sku: 'mg-prem-1', units: 30}
{customer: 'nimbus-11', event_ts: '2026-03-22T20:12:00Z', sku: 'MG-PREM-1', units: 30}
```
arjun-eng: sounds like SDK isn't normalizing sku or trimming metadata. ledger-bridge dedupe key uses raw sku so duplicates slip through.
lina-sales: partner is worried about a big invoice. we need a quick mitigation and a longer-term fix.
kevin-revops: short fix: ingest normalization rule -> lowercase sku + trim whitespace + collapse consecutive dashes. treat normalized_sku as canonical for aggregation. also add ingest.metadata.sku_normalized.
arjun-eng: longer term: release SDK patch to normalize on client side and add a validation mode that rejects events with inconsistent casing/whitespace. we'll bump SDK minor and publish release notes.
zoe-partnerops: comms: i'll tell NimbusGrid we'll run a one-time dedupe backfill for last 30 days and show a corrected preview. they asked for manual override to claim any rows intentionally duplicated.
partnerbot: webhook: /marketplace/webhook delivery succeeded 200 OK for partner NimbusGrid.
kevin-revops: owners: arjun -> ingest normalizer and SDK patch (owner: arjun-eng) by EOD tomorrow; kevin -> backfill job + preview by Friday; zoe -> partner comms and claim template by tomorrow.
zoe-partnerops: thanks. quick sync 9am tomorrow to sign off on preview link. :white_check_mark:
thread_text_snippet: NimbusGrid duplicates due to SDK sku casing/whitespace; plan: normalize sku at ingest, SDK patch, backfill preview, partner claim override
